title: Neden — Learn languages with videos
description: Built a tool that helps people learn a language while watching videos on a Mac. Click subtitle words for their meanings, ask AI to explain phrases, and replay dialogue without leaving the video.
seoTitle: Neden | Language learning with videos | Hanif Carroll
seoDescription: Learn a language while watching videos on a Mac. Look up subtitle words, ask AI to explain phrases, and replay dialogue without leaving the video.
role: Product design, development, and Mac integration
problem: Looking up unfamiliar dialogue in another app takes the learner away from the video and subtitles.
A translation can give the overall meaning without explaining how the words and grammar produce it.
solution: Added clickable subtitles, quick word lookup, and a panel for AI explanations and follow-up questions beside the video.
Built a Swift helper for incremental HTTPS responses and kept playback, conversation, and request ownership in the TypeScript plugin.
Stored provider keys in macOS Keychain. Phrase requests include the selected text, nearby subtitle cues, and conversation history.
result: Word lookup, AI explanations, and line replay work alongside the video and subtitles.
Public MIT-licensed source and a locally installable package, with broader native testing still to do.
